title: Can't find what you're looking for?
description:
Don't see what you are looking for?

Apply here to be added to our talent pool for future job openings that match your profile and career interests. Should a role open up that aligns with your experience, we’ll be in touch. We also strongly encourage you to follow us on our socials and keep an eye on nexamp.com/careers for future opportunities that spark your interest.

What we do:

We're a clean energy company working to make solar the easiest, most affordable energy choice. Our end-to-end capabilities—including project development and acquisition, design, construction, operations, and customer management—enable us to serve everyone from global enterprises to individual consumers with unmatched efficiency and reliability. With more than 1 GW of renewable energy-generating assets currently in operation or under construction, we're building a cleaner and more resilient energy future that works for everyone, and have been for nearly two decades. Headquartered in Boston and Chicago, we’re committed to serving communities nationwide.

If you thrive in moments of urgency, growth, and impact, we want you with us.

Team overview:

Accounting & Finance: Oversees accounting, financial planning and reporting, internal controls, cash management, and banking relationships, supporting budgeting, forecasting, and capital decisions.

Asset Management: Manages Nexamp’s owned and operated solar and storage assets to ensure optimal performance across all portfolios.

Business Development: Expands Nexamp’s distributed solar and storage pipeline through market outreach, site origination, landowner engagement, and lease negotiation.

Capital Markets: Leads capital raising efforts, investor relationships, and project- and portfolio-level investment diligence.

Channel Development: Acquires fully developed community solar and storage projects prior to construction.

Clean Energy Deployment (CED): Manages the end-to-end delivery of solar and storage projects, from planning and engineering through construction and interconnection.

Clean Energy Operations (CEO): Operates and maintains solar and storage assets to maximize energy production, financial performance, and long-term reliability.

Customer Experience & Operations: Supports community solar customers with seamless onboarding, subscription management, and ongoing service.

Legal: Provides strategic, practical legal guidance to protect Nexamp’s interests and support business objectives.

Marketing, Brand & Enrollment: Drives demand through brand storytelling, performance marketing, and customer lifecycle campaigns.

Nexamp Portfolio Operations (NPO): Represents investor interests by ensuring projects are financeable, on schedule, and smoothly transitioned to commercial operations.

People: Attracts, develops, and supports talent while fostering a values-driven, engaging employee experience.

Policy & Markets: Advances favorable policy outcomes and market strategies through regulatory leadership, analytics, and data-driven revenue modeling.

Product & Tech: Enables productivity and competitive advantage through product, software, data, IT, and enterprise technology solutions.

Transformation: Builds the organizational and operational foundation that helps Nexamp scale faster, smarter, and more profitably.

What you'll bring:

  • Mission Driven – Commitment to Nexamp's mission and a desire to build a smarter, stronger energy future.
  • Communication – Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization.
  • Delivering Results – Experience in taking initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across an organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality.
  • Problem Solving – Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions.
  • Customer Focus – Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry.
  • Business & Learning Acumen – Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions.

You’ll love working here because:

Not only will you get to take part in meaningful work and have the chance to change the world alongside innovative, dedicated, and motivated peers, but you will also have access to all the benefits that Nexamp offers! This includes our competitive compensation package; a 401(k) employer-match; health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one; flexible paid time off and holiday PTO; commuter benefits, and cell phone reimbursement. We have headquarters in Boston, MA, and Chicago, IL, in addition to growing offices nationwide. We provide healthy snacks, coffee, service days and other volunteer opportunities, company outings, and more!

title: Capital Markets Analyst
description:
Do you want to be a part of the clean energy movement? Are you passionate about improving our environment for this generation and those to follow? Are you ready to take on new challenges and collaborate with a future-focused team leading the way into new markets? Join Nexamp!

This is where you can learn from industry leaders and become one yourself. It's fast-paced, mission-based work that challenges the status quo. Be on the team that's changing the world.

What we’re looking for:

Nexamp is looking to hire a Capital Markets Analyst to join its Capital Markets team. You will support the Capital Markets and Project Finance team in evaluating, structuring, executing, and managing financing transactions across Nexamp’s distributed generation (“DG”) and utility-scale project portfolios. In this role you will be responsible for transaction execution, financial modeling, project finance analysis, funding coordination, and ongoing financing administration.

We are accepting candidates out of our Boston, MA office, where you will be hybrid. You will report to the Director, Capital Markets.

What you’ll do:

  • Maintain and enhance project-level and portfolio-level financial models for DG and utility-scale projects throughout the project lifecycle, including acquisition, development, financing, construction, and operations.
  • Perform financial analysis, scenario modeling, and sensitivity analysis to support project evaluation, investment decisions, financing structures, and new market or product opportunities.
  • Assist with the evaluation, structuring, negotiation, and execution of debt, tax equity, tax credit transfer, and other structured financing transactions for individual projects and project portfolios.
  • Coordinate internal transaction workstreams, maintain closing and funding checklists, track deliverables, and help ensure that required materials are completed accurately and on schedule throughout the transaction lifecycle.
  • Prepare and update transaction presentations, financing summaries, qualitative investment memoranda, and internal approval materials for senior management, investment committees, and financing counterparties.
  • Assist with the ongoing administration of financing facilities, including lender and investor reporting, covenant compliance tracking, consent and waiver requests, and coordination of inputs from internal teams and external counterparties.

What you’ll bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • At least 1 year of relevant experience in project finance, capital markets, investment banking, renewable energy finance, infrastructure finance, corporate finance, or financial planning and analysis.
  • Strong financial modeling skills, including experience building, maintaining, and auditing project-level and portfolio-level financial models.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, scenario and sensitivity analysis, data tables, and model organization and controls.
  • Working knowledge of project finance concepts, including cash flow forecasting, debt sizing, debt service coverage ratios, sources and uses, returns analysis, and financing assumptions.
  • Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to produce accurate financial analyses and transaction materials.
  • Ability to manage multiple analyses, deadlines, and transaction deliverables simultaneously.
  • Experience with distributed generation, community solar, utility-scale solar, energy storage, or other renewable energy assets preferred
  • Familiarity with one or more renewable energy financing structures, including construction debt, term debt, tax equity, tax credit transfer, back-leverage, or portfolio financing preferred.
  • Familiarity with renewable energy incentives and programs, including the Investment Tax Credit, Production Tax Credit, tax credit transferability, and relevant state-level programs preferred.
  • Commitment to Nexamp's mission and have a passion for solving tomorrow's climate crisis today.
  • Demonstrated experience in effectively communicating information, ideas, and perspectives with people inside and beyond your organization.
  • Experience in showcasing initiative to make improvements to current work, processes, products, and services across the organization. We value accountability and an ownership mentality.
  • Ability to ask appropriate questions, analyze data, identify the root causes of problems, and present creative solutions.
  • Expertise in building strong internal and external relationships with customers and stakeholders, instilling trust and loyalty across the industry.
  • Eagerness to develop a fundamental understanding of how Nexamp operates and then apply that knowledge effectively to inform business decisions.
